g.aria-label: Three Complementary Decoder Losses in VQGAN / Latent Diffusion VAEs
Anchors low-frequency color and layout, blurs fine textures
Preserves mid-level structure, permits repetitive grid artifacts
Local Convolutional Discriminator on Every N × N Patch
Forces decoder to commit to crisp high-frequency textures
Latent diffusion autoencoders (e.g., Stable Diffusion's) use PatchGAN-trained decoders
